name: cursor-drive
description: Your AI pair-programming driver for Cursor. Voice-first, multi-agent, share-screen. Integrates via Cursor Plugin + MCP server.

commands.title: Discover All Cursor Commands (full list by prefix)
Focus Agent View (open Agents panel + layout)

enumDescriptions: Clarify goals and generate a plan artifact before execution
Execute autonomously — propose code changes and commands
Diagnose issues with evidence-first debugging steps
cursorDrive.defaultSubMode.description: Default sub-mode applied when drive mode activates

cursorDrive.tts.enabled.description: Enable text-to-speech responses. Drive will speak agent responses aloud.

cursorDrive.tts.voice.description: Voice name to use for TTS. Leave blank for system default. For Windows: e.g. 'Microsoft David Desktop'. For macOS: e.g. 'Alex'.

cursorDrive.tts.speed.description: Speech rate multiplier. 1.0 is normal speed.

cursorDrive.tts.maxSpokenSentences.description: Maximum sentences spoken per response. Remainder is still shown in chat.

cursorDrive.tts.interruptOnInput.description: Stop speaking immediately when the user sends a new message.

cursorDrive.operators.maxConcurrent.description: Max simultaneous Drive operators. Each operator is a senior autonomous worker that can spawn its own subagents.

cursorDrive.operators.maxSubAgentsPerOpe.description: Max Cursor Task-tool subagents each operator can spawn concurrently.

cursorDrive.operators.defaultPermissionP.description: Default permission preset for new operators.

cursorDrive.operators.namePool.description: Names assigned to operators when spawned (first available used).

cursorDrive.agentScreen.enabled.description: Enable the Agent Screen (S-AS) panel that shows operator activity in real time.

cursorDrive.agentScreen.autoOpen.description: Automatically open the Agent Screen panel when Drive activates.

cursorDrive.agentScreen.displayMode.description: How the Agent Screen is displayed.

cursorDrive.agentScreen.clickBehavior.description: Behavior when clicking file paths in the Agent Screen.

cursorDrive.agentScreen.showPlanProgress.description: Show plan progress overlay (active plan, TODO counts) in the Agent Screen.

cursorDrive.statusBar.showModeLabel.description: When true, status bar shows 'Drive > Agent' (or Plan/Ask/Debug). When false, in agent mode shows only 'Drive' (or 'Drive | Operator') so 'Drive' is the main label.

cursorDrive.statusBar.activeBackground.description: Optional hex color (e.g. #0e639c) for status bar when Drive is active. Empty uses theme (statusBarItem.warningBackground).

cursorDrive.mcp.port.description: Port for the Drive MCP server. Register in .cursor/mcp.json as { url: 'http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp' }.

cursorDrive.cursorCli.command.description: Cursor CLI command: 'agent' (standalone from cursor.com/install) or 'cursor' (then uses 'cursor agent -p ...'). Used for cursor_cli_run and POST /run.

cursorDrive.cursorCli.timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds for a Cursor CLI run (cursor_cli_run and POST /run).

cursorDrive.wakeWord.description: Voice phrase that activates Drive when inactive.

cursorDrive.voice.autoActivateMicOnToggl.description: Automatically open the chat panel and start Cursor's voice input when Drive mode is toggled on.

cursorDrive.voice.chatOpenCommand.description: VS Code command used to open the chat panel when activating voice input.

cursorDrive.voice.micCommand.description: VS Code/Cursor command used to activate the microphone/voice input in chat. Leave blank to skip mic trigger.

cursorDrive.voice.stopCommand.description: Command used by cursorDrive.stopVoice to submit the current voice dictation. Falls back to stopListening (cancel) if unavailable.

cursorDrive.voice.showListeningFeedback.description: When true, show a brief 'Listening…' toast when voice input (mic) is activated.

cursorDrive.syncNativeMode.description: When switching Drive sub-modes, also call the matching Cursor native composerMode.* command to keep Cursor's UI in sync.

cursorDrive.operators.autoInjectOpenFile.description: Automatically inject the active editor file into Composer when spawning a new operator.

cursorDrive.submitWord.description: Voice phrase that confirms and submits the prompt; bypasses prompt optimizer when present.

cursorDrive.promptOptimizer.enabled.description: Enable AI prompt rewriting for voice/dictation prompts.

cursorDrive.promptOptimizer.autoApprove.description: Skip approval QuickPick; auto-use optimized prompt when available.

cursorDrive.agents.tangentKeyword.description: Keyword that triggers operator spawning (e.g. 'tangent refactor auth' spawns an operator for that task).

cursorDrive.agents.tangentConfirmationTi.description: Milliseconds to wait before re-prompting for tangent confirmation ('Before I begin, I need your confirmation').

cursorDrive.agents.autoConfirmTangent.description: Skip tangent agent confirmation flow; spawn and begin immediately.

cursorDrive.agents.delegateConfirmation.description: Allow another agent to confirm on behalf of the user (via MCP or hotkey).

cursorDrive.privacy.transcriptPersistenc.description: Store transcripts locally when Drive is active (disabled by default per ADR-0005).

cursorDrive.privacy.transcriptRetentionD.description: Days to keep transcript logs before auto-deletion. Only applies when transcriptPersistence is enabled.
